$comment: The properties zpool create gives the pool that holds imp's datasets, as its arguments before the pool name. bun run render:deploy writes them into deploy/bootstrap/storage.sh and bootstrap.sh's copy; scripts/lib/parse-zfs-pool.ts parses this file for render:deploy and the zfs test harnesses, and e2e/test-bootstrap.sh reads it. impd sets recordsize on the datasets it makes, so the pool's root keeps the default.
